text:
ava: heads up — weird eviction wave in us-west2 over the last 10m. lots of tiny GPU pods getting evicted with reason 'taint: shelf-reserve'.

sam: saw it. reserve_rebalancer metric toggling between us-west2a and b every 2-3m. looks like the new shelf-reserve heuristic is moving the reserved rack target and we keep shifting placement. :eyes:

neha: grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/placement/az-reserve?orgId=1&from=now-15m to=now — you can see rack-level allocation jump.

infra-bot: autoscaler: scaled up pool-gpu-us-west2a by +4 nodes (spot), reason=reserve-fill.

miguel: log snippet from kube-scheduler: ```I0320 12:34:01.123 scheduler.go: evicting pod default/model-train-9 due to taint "shelf-reserve=true:PreferNoSchedule"; node has_reserved_quota=false```

ava: consequence — we get churn (pods bounce), KV cache warm misses, and CPU for sidecars spikes. cost + spot churn up ~18% in last 30m.

sam: quick checks: `kubectl get pods -n infra -o wide --field-selector=status.phase==Pending` and `kubectl describe node <node>` for the evicted host. also check warmpool allocation logs.

neha: mitigation idea — pause the rebalancer for 15m and increase reserve_hysteresis_seconds from 120 to 600 so it doesn't flip on small usage fluctuations.

miguel: agree. also we should prefer not to evict non-preemptible customer pods. our current score weights treat reserved rack preference > pod_preemption_risk which is backwards.

ava: can we hotfix config? opsbot, can you open a mitigation runbook ticket and patch config?

opsbot: created INF-1423: "shelf-reserve oscillation — temp pause & hysteresis bump" and linked to runbook. https://redwood.atlassian/INF-1423 :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: rollback option available: set reserve_strategy=static for pool-gpu-us-west2 for 30m.

sam: I'll apply static for 30m and watch. will also throttle rebalancer trigger to 10m.

neha: after we stabilise, follow-ups: 1) lower eviction priority for on-demand pods, 2) add 10m moving average to reserved_rack_signal, 3) postmortem and cost impact calc.

miguel: add a test in the scheduler sim for oscillating reserve targets (shock test) — caught this in prod today.

ava: thanks. keeping an eye on it. ping me if anything changes. :thumbsup:

sam: update 12:36 — after setting static reserve, eviction rate dropped to baseline. will leave config in place for 45m and open a PR to add hysteresis.

neha: noted for postmortem. assigning INF-1423 to eng-platform oncall.

ava: ack. we'll include cost delta and warm-pool kcps in the writeup.

(ends)
